name: Masami Takei
source:
Masami Takei is a former Tanzaku Quarter resident, where she had a normal civilian life being the mother of [url=https://vndb.org/c105086]Koji Takei[/url]. Masami has light brown hair and yellow eyes. After the last events, she found herself in a corner and had to reveal her clan history to Konoha. Now she lives at Konoha with Koji supporting him in his journey to save those who got caught. Besides not being a Kunoichi, Masami has taught Koji how to use his chakra to climb trees and walk in the water.
